scope: Windows application with explicit platform selection. Native PC formats and supported PS2 memory-card exports have separate parsers, validation and backup identities.
pursuit_policy: Implement only evidenced platform-specific save formats. Published-format availability is labelled separately from independent genuine-file and in-game verification.
console_scope: Only source-backed DW4 XL PS2 SLUS-20812 PSU editing currently; other console formats are unimplemented.
pc_scope_exclusions: Dynasty Warriors 1–3 original console editions and console-only expansions
